companiesShowcase.title: Showcase Of Our Companies
companiesShowcase.subtitle: Three of our flagship companies demonstrate how Al-Jarrah Group delivers value across agriculture, logistics, and healthcare support.

rdc.name: Rural Development Company
rdc.summary: RDC has supported Iraq's agricultural modernization for decades through high-value equipment, long-term partnerships, and technical support.
rdc.pointOne: Exclusive John Deere dealer for agricultural equipment since 1998, with expansion into Turf and Gator lines in 2016.
rdc.pointTwo: Provides supply, installation, and maintenance for tractors, cultivators, combines, balers, and turf mowers.
rdc.pointThree: Works with key Iraqi institutions including the Ministry of Agriculture, SCAS, CBI, and Ministry of Finance.
rdc.pointFour: Maintains long-term industrial partnerships with international engineering and heavy-industry suppliers.

alghadak.name: Alghadak Warehouses
alghadak.summary: Alghadak operates one of the largest private cold-storage and warehousing compounds in Baghdad, serving food and beverage distribution.
alghadak.pointOne: Cold storage capacity reaches approximately 1,000 tons cooling, with reliable temperature-controlled operations.
alghadak.pointTwo: Flexible unit sizes include dry stores (500, 1000, 2000 m2) and temperature-controlled stores (250, 500, 750 m2).
alghadak.pointThree: Located in Awareej, Baghdad, on a 50,000 square meter compound strategically connected to southern access routes.
alghadak.pointFour: Supports both short-term and long-term warehousing with secure and adaptable storage solutions.

alkafaat.name: Al-Kafaat Hospital
alkafaat.summary: Al-Kafaat Hospital represents the group's healthcare commitment through patient-focused medical services and operational care quality.
alkafaat.pointOne: Supports the health sector with professional clinical services and modern care standards.
alkafaat.pointTwo: Built around dependable operations, safety, and quality-of-care practices for patients and families.
alkafaat.pointThree: Detailed facility and service information can be expanded directly from the official hospital website content.
alkafaat.pointFour: Reflects the group's broader mission to deliver trusted essential services that improve community wellbeing.

about.title: A Forward-Thinking Collective Built on Excellence, Innovation, and Trust
about.paragraphOne: At Al-Jarrah Group, we are more than just a holding company. We are a forward-thinking collective of businesses built on a foundation of excellence, innovation, and trust. With a diverse portfolio of companies under our umbrella, we strive to create lasting value for our clients, partners, and communities through every venture we pursue.
about.paragraphTwo: What sets Al-Jarrah Group apart is our unwavering commitment to building genuine relationships. We value the trust our clients place in us and work tirelessly to nurture partnerships that stand the test of time. Through collaboration, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, we empower our businesses to thrive in competitive markets while contributing to the growth of the industries we serve.
about.paragraphThree: Our team is the driving force behind everything we do. United by shared values and a passion for success, we bring together expertise from different sectors to deliver holistic solutions tailored to the needs of our clients.
about.paragraphFour: We take pride in our unique approach, combining global standards with local insight, allowing us to stand out as a trusted and dynamic partner. For us, success is not only about achieving business results; it is about creating positive impact and leaving a legacy of professionalism, reliability, and excellence.
about.paragraphFive: The group consists of various companies founded in 1976, specializing in industrial, agricultural, and commercial fields with multiple general agencies. The founder and chairman of the board is Engineer Dhergham Al-Jarrah. The board of directors consists of five members with different specializations, all actively participating in administering the group.
about.legacyText: Guided by 50 years of business excellence, we continue building on the foundation of trust and innovation established from our founding.
about.profileSectorsValue: Agricultural, Food Industry, Industrial, Health Sector, Real Estate
about.approachParagraphOne: At Al-Jarrah Group, we do not just provide products and services, we build lasting relationships. Our success is measured by the success of our partners, which is why we take a comprehensive approach to every engagement.
about.approachParagraphTwo: From initial consultation through delivery and ongoing support, our team works closely with each partner to understand unique challenges and objectives. We combine international best practices with deep local market knowledge to deliver solutions that truly fit.
about.integrationParagraph: With three specialized companies operating across agriculture, construction, and logistics, we provide an integrated service model that simplifies execution and improves accountability.
about.integrationBenefitThree: One trusted partner for multiple needs
